desc: Build an adjacency list representation of the graph from the input constraints and initialize arrays for visited status and relative XOR distances.
Implement a BFS/DFS traversal for each connected component to detect contradictions and compute relative XOR distances ($D_v$) from a chosen root.
For each valid component, analyze each bit position (0 to 29) to determine the optimal bit for the root value that minimizes the sum of elements in that component.
Calculate the final value for each node in each component based on the optimal root value and the precomputed relative distances.
Output the resulting sequence A or -1 if any contradiction was detected during the traversal.
